WHO standard: under 18.5 underweight, 18.5-24.9 normal, 25-29.9 overweight, 30 and above obese. Asian populations tend to carry more body fat at the same BMI, so the Chinese standard has a lower upper limit.
BMR和TDEE有什么区别？活动系数怎么选？: What is the difference between BMR and TDEE? How do I choose the activity factor?
BMR（基础代谢率）是人体安静状态下维持生命所需的最低热量，本工具采用Miffl: BMR (basal metabolic rate) is the minimum energy needed to sustain life at rest, calculated here with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation. TDEE (total daily energy expenditure) = BMR × activity factor, reflecting total burn including daily activity and exercise. Bedridden is about 1.2, lightly active 1.375, moderately active 1.55, very active 1.725 and extremely active 1.9; pick the level closest to your weekly exercise frequency.
